persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrībhūpatīndramalla deva asana śrīśrīśrītaleju ske gajuri jīrṇoddhāra yāṅā deśabaliviyāyā thva sāphula

purpose: śrīśrīśrītaleju ske gajuri jīrṇoddhāra yāṅā deśabaliviyāyā thva sāphula (for the ritual performance of the deśabali offering during the restoration of the finial of Taleju)
